QA-29237 is PASS. The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-29237-report.md`.

- **Setup:** Monday means account HBO Max with brand HBO Max (exact spec name), on the Impressions data set with TikTok only, Jan 01 – Dec 31, 2023.
- **A5 (Impressions):** All 200 rendered posts show a numeric Impressions value. Organic and Paid Impressions show "–" on all 200, so both parts pass.
- **A6 (Reach):** This passes only vacuously. Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach are "–" on every TikTok post, so there is nothing to sum. The report notes this as a possible spec or data gap, not a bug (same as the 2026-10-20 UCLA run).
- **A7 (Engagement Rate):** Engagement Rate matches Engagements / Impressions × 100 within display rounding on all 200 posts.
- **Coverage:** Table View renders only the top 200 of 1,993 TikTok posts, so the per-post checks cover those 200. The Sum row covers all posts.

I followed the Description table for the weekday rotation, not the "Notes" line, which disagrees with it. That is the same call as QA-29235 today.
